study: Fixed-recipe appended-SVD comparison; no new model fitting or selection

verification.method: Direct NumPy SSE/SST arithmetic from private OOF CSVs and raw labels
verification.scope: Hashes, exact IDs/targets/folds, equal mean and retained metrics; saved-model reconstruction is separately performed by mercedes evaluate

interpretation.projection: Appended SVD retains all inputs; no new information or compression
interpretation.seeds: Same folds; projection recipe changes SVD and tree seeds together. Ridge is deterministic conditional on representation, not across refitted SVDs.
interpretation.diagnostics: Post-fit descriptions do not identify bad labels or justify deletion
interpretation.selection: Predeclared equal mean; no OOF weight search or winner promotion
interpretation.limits: Two seeds, one split plan, CPU models; no leaderboard or production claim
